title: Taiwanese Student Association at Georgia Tech
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association at Georgia Tech (GT TSA) is a registered student organization at the Georgia Institute of Technology in Atlanta, Georgia. It is listed in Georgia Tech’s official Engage club directory (gatech.campuslabs.com) as well as in the OMED Student Resource Hub, confirming its status as a recognized campus organization. The organization maintains an Instagram presence at @gt.tsa and a Facebook group under the handle gttsa.

GT TSA serves primarily students from Taiwan and engages the broader campus community through cultural programming. Among its signature events is the Double Tenth Banquet, held annually in October to coincide with Taiwan’s National Day, featuring talent shows, games, and Taiwanese cuisine. The organization also runs career-oriented programming, including workshops and a Career Salon podcast series that has brought in guest speakers to share professional and internship guidance with members.
